video_summary.overall_goal: Start a short battery temperature logging session and return to the launcher after it finishes.
video_summary.description: The recording shows the Battery Temperature app with a 25.0 °C reading. The user changes the notification icon text color from Black to White, starts temperature logging for 1 minute, waits for the logging-finished confirmation, and then goes to the Android launcher.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Battery Temperature main screen is visible with the current temperature, a graph, logging controls, alarm settings, auto-start option, kill app and exit control, and notification icon text color radio options.
steps.system_response: The screen remains on the Battery Temperature app with no navigation change.
steps.visual_feedback: The temperature value remains visible and the Black radio option is selected.
steps.intent_task: Review the current battery temperature and logging settings before making a change.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The lower part of the Battery Temperature main screen is visible, including the notification icon text color options.
steps.system_response: The notification icon text color selection changes to White.
steps.visual_feedback: The White radio button becomes selected and the Black radio option becomes unselected.
steps.intent_task: Change the notification icon text color setting.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Battery Temperature screen shows Log for 1 minutes and the START LOGGING button.
steps.system_response: Temperature logging starts and the button changes from START LOGGING to STOP LOGGING.
steps.visual_feedback: The button label changes to STOP LOGGING.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Battery Temperature screen remains visible while logging is active.
steps.visual_feedback: The STOP LOGGING button remains visible.
steps.intent_task: Wait for the logging session to complete.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Battery Temperature screen shows the logging controls after the session completes.
steps.system_response: The app reports that temperature logging finished and the logging button returns to START LOGGING.
steps.visual_feedback: A Temperature logging finished snackbar appears near the bottom of the screen.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Android app launcher is visible with a grid of app icons and a Temperature logging finished snackbar at the bottom.
steps.system_response: The app closes to the Android launcher.
steps.visual_feedback: The launcher appears while the Temperature logging finished snackbar is still visible.
steps.intent_task: Leave the app after logging completes.

overall_flow: View the Battery Temperature main screen.
Change notification icon text color from Black to White.
human_readable_step_summary: Step 1: The app shows the battery temperature and logging settings.
Step 2: The user selects White for the notification icon text color.
Step 3: The user taps START LOGGING to begin logging temperature.
Step 4: The app keeps logging and shows STOP LOGGING.
Step 5: The app reports that temperature logging finished.
Step 6: The user returns to the Android launcher.
